title: BiCAA: Bidirectional Credit Assignment for Search-Augmented Agent
abstract: arXiv:2608.01321v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: By iteratively retrieving and integrating external evidence, multi-step search enables search-augmented agents to tackle complex question answering. However, vanilla GRPO assigns rewards based solely on final answers, providing limited guidance for intermediate search steps. To provide fine-grained process feedback, we evaluate the value of each search step: it should acquire evidence that advances problem solving while avoiding redundant retrieval. Building on these complementary criteria, we introduce BiCAA, which combines Forward Solvability Gain (FSG) and Subsequent Reasoning Gain (SRG) for bidirectional credit assignment. To reward progress in evidence acquisition, FSG quantifies changes in ground-truth answer likelihood after each interaction. translated_title: BiCAA：面向搜索增强智能体的双向信用分配
translated_abstract: 通过迭代检索和整合外部证据，多步搜索使搜索增强智能体能够解决复杂的问答任务。然而，原始的GRPO仅根据最终答案分配奖励，对中间搜索步骤提供的指导有限。为了提供细粒度的过程反馈，我们评估每个搜索步骤的价值：它应该获取能够推进问题解决的证据，同时避免冗余检索。基于这些互补的评估标准，我们提出了BiCAA，它结合了前向可解性增益和后续推理增益来实现双向信用分配。为了奖励证据获取的进展，FSG量化每次交互后真实答案似然的变化。SRG通过比较有和没有当前交互时后续动作的似然，来近似衡量当前交互对后续推理的支持程度，并将这种支持作为代理信号……
tldr: 提出BiCAA方法，通过前向可解性增益（FSG）和后续推理增益（SRG）进行双向信用分配，为搜索增强智能体的每个中间搜索步骤提供细粒度的过程奖励，兼顾证据获取进展与避免冗余检索。
en_tdlr: BiCAA introduces bidirectional credit assignment by combining Forward Solvability Gain (FSG) and Subsequent Reasoning Gain (SRG) to provide fine-grained process rewards for each intermediate search step of search-augmented agents, rewarding evidence acquisition progress while avoiding redundant retrieval.
